registration_note: The rules below are fixed from this instant. A score is OFFICIAL only if its outcome became observable strictly after registered_at; earlier outcomes are scored under the same rules but reported in a separate PRE_REGISTRATION bucket and never enter an official aggregate.

aggregation.role_note: role is control for placebo arms and candidate otherwise; a stream-level rollup never pools the two

bootstrap.rng: splitmix64 seeded by the first 8 bytes of sha256(rule_id|metric|group key|window)

resolution.price_available_at: max(pull_timestamp, 16:00 America/New_York on the observation date); a close is never available before its session closes

e2.direction.v1.applies_to: call.kind == direction (side +1/-1 on one instrument, entry close -> exit close)

metrics.hit: 1 if side * return > 0, 0 if side * return < 0; return == 0 is a push (void, reason push)
metrics.net_return: cost_model.json formula for the target's instrument_class; absent for not_tradable

e2.probability.v1.applies_to: call.kind == probability (p of the declared event, event 'up' = exit close > entry close)

metrics.log_loss: -(y ln p + (1 - y) ln (1 - p)) with p clipped to [1e-6, 1 - 1e-6]

e2.rank_ic.v1.applies_to: call.kind == rank_score; unit = (stream, family, horizon, entry date)

metrics.rank_ic: Spearman correlation between score and realized return across the unit's resolved members (average ranks for ties)

gex.level_hold.v1.applies_to: GEX-levels v1 tested level (flip, put wall, call wall) or its mirror placebo, per session

metrics.hit: 1 if the level's first reach held (closed on the open's side), 0 if it broke; gap_through and not-reached are void (pre-registration H2 definitions)

gex.h3_net_pnl.v1.applies_to: GEX-levels v1 H3 rule trade (real walls, and the mirror-placebo walls as a control), per session

metrics.net_return: cost_model.json us_equity_etf_large applied to the logged raw entry and exit prices (NOT the pre-registration's 1 bp/side)

s10.ts_ic.v1.applies_to: S10 hypothesis forward-log candidate; unit = candidate

metrics.signed_ic: direction * the candidate's pre-registered statistic (spearman or pearson) over the first min_n valid pairs in decision order, recomputed from the log and checked against the S10 verdict

s10_hypothesis_forward_v1.disclosure_note: The S10 pre-registration allows one look per candidate. E2 logs predictions and outcomes as activity but emits no score for a candidate until its S10 verdict record exists.

gex_levels_v1.disclosure_note: The GEX pre-registration evaluates once at 60 valid sessions; any earlier look is labelled interim and cannot stop, extend or change the test. Every GEX aggregate carries interim=true until 60 valid sessions.
